Container.Name: MailFlow-frontend
Container.Overview: Browser interface for MailFlow, a self-hosted webmail client for existing IMAP/SMTP accounts. Serves the React application through nginx and proxies API/WebSocket requests to the configured backend address and port. HTTPS uses a generated self-signed certificate unless you provide cert.pem and key.pem. HTTP is intended for a trusted TLS-terminating reverse proxy.
Container.Requires: Requires a running MailFlow-backend with its PostgreSQL and Redis services configured. Set BACKEND_HOST to the reachable Unraid host address and BACKEND_PORT to the backend mapped host port. Set backend APP_URL and FRONTEND_URL to the URL users visit. Certificate storage must be writable.

Config.Name: HTTPS web interface
Config.Description: Host HTTPS port. Change if occupied; the WebUI link follows this mapping.

Config.Name: HTTP reverse-proxy port
Config.Description: Host HTTP port for a TLS-terminating reverse proxy. Forward X-Forwarded-Proto: https. Restrict access appropriately.

Config.Name: TLS certificate storage
Config.Description: Persistent writable certificate directory. Supply cert.pem and key.pem, or the container generates a self-signed pair at startup.

Config.Name: Backend host address
Config.Description: Required: Unraid host IPv4 address or resolvable hostname where the backend port is published. Do not use localhost or the backend container name with default bridge networking.

Config.Name: Backend port
Config.Description: Required: backend mapped host port, default 3220. Must match Backend API host port in the backend template, not its internal port 3000.

Config.Name: Application URL
Config.Description: Optional frontend compatibility setting: use the same browser-facing URL as backend APP_URL. Frontend consumption is not yet verified; this does not replace the required backend URL settings.
